tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The dispute broadly related to Demand of 18% GST of Rs.509.04 lakhs on the amount reported in a memorandum GL named as "Invoices to be Sent" during the F.Y. 2020-2021 to FY. 2023-24. The GST authority presumed it as turnover on which tax has not been paid/Invoices not raised. The notice alleges that the supply has been made to the extent of Rs.2828.00 lakhs reflecting in this Memorandum GL and GST @18% has not been paid/invoices were not issued at the time of supply. The Company has a very strong case to defend as the SCN is incorrect and has made a wrong GST demand.

tax_litigation.status: Reply was filed on 17-09-2026. Personal Hearing was fixed for 06-10-2026 before Additional Commissioner, Ludhiana. Order is awaited

operating_notes.text: Partial commercial production of Polymer (Adhesive) at the Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Performance Polymers facility began June 03, 2026, following the November 04, 2025 expansion approval.
The remaining capacity at the same facility is expected to be commissioned in 6 to 8 months.
The Agri Division includes fertilizers, crop nutrition, bio-catalysts, and plant growth regulators.
The Performance Polymers and Chemicals Division (remaining business) includes adhesives, wood finishes, and specialty chemicals.
Post-demerger, the company will be renamed Jubilant Industries Limited.
Company sanctioned ₹50 Cr brownfield capex at Vadodara to add 30,000 MTPA SBR latex capacity, targeted for completion by end of Q3FY27.
Received GST show cause notice from Ludhiana Commissionerate for ₹5.09 Cr covering FY21 to FY24.
Held NCLT-convened equity shareholders meeting for the proposed demerger scheme with Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
Equity shareholders approved the Scheme of Arrangement for Demerger of Agri Business into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited with 99.99% votes in favour.
Unsecured creditors approved the demerger scheme of Agri Business into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited with 100% majority.
NCLT Allahabad Bench issued order directing statutory notices on demerger second motion petition, fixing next hearing for December 3, 2026.

timeline.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited’s promoters—Mr. Shyam Sunder Bhartia, Mr. Hari Shanker Bhartia, and Promoter Group—declared no encumbrances on shares for FY2026 on 02-04-2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹485.2 Cr (+21.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹19.93 Cr (+24.5% YoY).
Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹485.2 Cr and PAT of ₹19.93 Cr.

Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products partially commenced commercial production of Polymer (Adhesive) at its expanded Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Performance Polymers facility on June 03, 2026, with the remaining capacity expected in 6-8 months.
NCLT convened a meeting of equity shareholders for September 05, 2026, to approve the demerger of the Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
The company issued notice for the NCLT-convened meeting of unsecured creditors to be held on September 05, 2026, for the proposed demerger of its Agri Division.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹523.18 Cr (+18.4% YoY), net profit ₹46.11 Cr (+4.5% YoY).
2026-08-11: Company reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹523.18 Cr and announced a ₹50 Cr brownfield SBR latex expansion.
Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products received a GST show cause notice of ₹5.09 Cr for the period FY21 to FY24.
Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited’s 18th AGM held on September 01, 2026, passed all resolutions with requisite majority via VC/OAVM.
Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products held its NCLT-convened equity shareholders meeting on September 5, 2026, for the proposed demerger scheme.
JUBLCPL shareholders approved the demerger scheme with Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited with 99.99% majority at the NCLT-convened meeting.
CARE Ratings reaffirmed CARE A+ (Stable) / CARE A1+ ratings on bank facilities of ₹625 Cr and withdrew long-term bank facilities.
Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products received an NCLT order dated October 8, 2026, directing notice issuance for its demerger second motion petition with a hearing set for December 3, 2026.
